item.title: You either have power and will spend it to make change or you do not have power or you are unwilling to spend it
item.description:
You either have power and will spend it to make change or you do not have power or you are unwilling to spend it. It seems the vast majority of people are under the belief that they are unwilling to spend it, in which case I question how we can build power that can actually fight the NYPD, and the answer seems very clearly not to be through elections but to be through exactly the criticism and conscious raising and mobilisation that is developed through properly characterising electoral ism.
